method: Fresh Node.js vm execution of each published payload in an isolated registration-only context; no browser, fetch, filesystem APIs or network exposed to the payload.

latestRelease.scope: 截至核验日，官方仓库标记为 Latest 的正式发行版。当前文档仍依据下列 main 提交快照，包含不同版本语境；静态包不会联网自动更新版本号。

baselineComparison.note: A subsequent full build applied the API-name restoration fix. Four authorized Journaling tags and one qualified API label were subsequently synchronized by complete-paragraph/card matches in their respective content blocks and same-page search records. These exact patches are separately recorded. Payload changes are recorded here, and final content correctness is independently revalidated against the source/review inputs.

limitations: This executes data registration and parses app scripts; it does not operate a browser or assert visual layout.
